purpose: Teach: アキ/垂れ/行儀/ドーナツ/スナック/埃/味わえる/うんと

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新スタッフのアキちゃん、本気で、絶対、優しい人ね、メイちゃん、本気で、感心
lines.en: Aoi, this new staff member Aki—I'm being serious, she's genuinely such a kind person. I really do admire her.
lines.style: Warm, animated opening. Genuine enthusiasm rising through the phrase. A beat of sincere emphasis on the compliment. Reaching slightly, like wanting Aoi to see what Mei sees.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。ソース、本気で、絶対、垂れないように、メイちゃん、葵で、お皿、絶対、設計、こだわってるのよ、本気で、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. The sauce—I'm really particular about the plate design so it won't drip. I actually spend a lot of care on that.
lines.style: Thoughtful and matter-of-fact. Pride quietly threaded through the explanation. Voice steady and grounded, almost intimate—sharing a detail Aoi doesn't usually talk about. Slight lean inward.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお客様、本気で、絶対、行儀、絶対、いい方ばかりよね、メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、感心
lines.en: Your customers really do have such good manners, Aoi. I'm genuinely impressed by that.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. A genuine compliment delivered without performance. Slight pause before 'impressed,' like she's choosing the word carefully. Warm and direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新メニューに、本気で、絶対、ドーナツ、絶対、加えたわよ、メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、絶対、味わってみて、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: We added donuts to the new menu—you should really try one. I'd love to know what you think.
lines.style: Bright and inviting. An offer wrapped in genuine curiosity. Voice opens on 'donuts' like sharing something new and good. Ends with a lift that asks for her opinion.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、本気で、絶対、スナック、絶対、お子様向けに、絶対、出してるのよね、メイちゃん、本気で、感心、本気で、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: You really do think about your customers, don't you? Putting out special snacks for the kids—that's the kind of thing I really admire about you.
lines.style: Warm observation with genuine surprise underneath. Like noticing something good and wanting to name it out loud. Soft and sincere. No rush. Ends with real gratitude.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵で、本気で、絶対、埃、絶対、たまらないように、絶対、毎日、絶対、お掃除、徹底してるよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: I'm really particular about keeping the place dust-free too. Every single day—it's something I'm careful about.
lines.style: Practical and matter-of-fact, but with quiet pride. Not defensive, just honest about the work. Voice settles into the detail like it matters. Steady rhythm, no apology.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のコーヒー、本気で、絶対、深い味、味わえるよね、メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、絶対、本気、本気、絶対、本気で、本気で、絶対、感謝。
lines.en: Your coffee has such depth to it, Aoi. When I drink it here, I can really taste that care. I'm genuinely grateful for that.
lines.style: Tender and reflective. Building slowly toward the gratitude. A pause before 'grateful' to let the feeling land. Vulnerable but steady. The voice of someone recognizing something true.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様、本気で、絶対、うんと、絶対、お洒落な、葵で、本気で、絶対、過ごしていただきたい
lines.en: I really want all our customers to have a lovely, comfortable experience here with us at Aoi's place.
lines.style: Warm and genuine, with quiet conviction underneath. Opening soft and sincere. Gentle pace. Ending on a note of care and inclusion—'with us.' A tender close to the moment.
